w10_T4_000107: Sofia's cart, one of a dozen in the stadium, holds 225 hot dogs at opening, and she restocks 75 more at half-time of each match, selling all of them. She works 7 matches in a season. At the final she sells 33 extra hot dogs. Each hot dog costs 5 dollars. How many dollars does Sofia take in over the season?
w10_T4_000121: In the morning Farah's shop had 63 umbrellas; a delivery of 61 arrived, then a second supplier brought 65 more, and she moved every umbrella onto the front display. In the afternoon 18 umbrellas were sold from the display. In the evening a storm broke and 140 umbrellas were sold. Her rival Gabe, across the street, sold fewer umbrellas than Farah that day. How many umbrellas are left on Farah's front display?
w10_T4_000125: In the morning the boat landed 220 kilograms of fish, then hauled in 63 kilograms more and a further 9 kilograms. The crew is 4 people. In the afternoon the last net brought 61 kilograms. In the evening the whole catch went to a cannery, where each kilogram fills 5 tins and each tin sells for 5 dollars. How many dollars is the catch worth in tins?
w10_T4_000129: In the morning Ivan had 36 tokens at the fair and won 30 more at the ring toss. In the afternoon he spent 47 tokens on rides, 9 tokens on a game, and 6 tokens on popcorn. In the evening a booth exchanged each of his remaining tokens for 5 raffle tickets. His friend Zara, who had won far more raffle tickets than Ivan, gave him 74 of hers. How many raffle tickets does Ivan have?
w10_T4_000130: In the morning the copy shop's printer produced 12 sheets a minute for 6 minutes, and 60 of those sheets went straight out to morning orders. In the afternoon each remaining sheet was cut into 4 strips, and each strip was folded into 5 raffle tickets. In the evening every ticket sold for 7 dollars. How many dollars did the tickets bring in?
w10_T4_000137: In the morning Hana counted 203 pastries in her cafe, and the bakery delivered 78 more. The cafe has 14 tables. In the afternoon she sold every pastry at 5 dollars each and collected 16 dollars in tips. In the evening she paid the supplier 293 dollars. Her brother Kenji's stall took in less money than Hana's cafe that day. How many dollars does Hana have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000139: In the morning 145 dogs were boarding at the kennel, and 141 were collected by their owners after the show. The kennel has 30 runs. Each dog that stayed was given 7 treats, and the treats were piled in a bowl. In the afternoon a visitor added 28 treats to the bowl, and the dogs ate 9. In the evening the manager bought exactly as many treats as were in the bowl and added them, doubling the pile. How many treats are in the bowl?
w10_T4_000141: In the morning the seed company received 9 crates of 149 packets each, and 682 packets were shipped out right away. In the afternoon the staff opened the remaining packets: each packet holds 6 sachets, and each sachet holds 3 seeds. In the evening the manager valued each seed at 7 cents and added up that value for 4 sowing seasons, assuming the same seeds each season. How many cents does the manager's total come to?
w10_T4_000142: Bea had 140 marbles. She won 45 in a game and was given 16 by her aunt. She then gave 133 marbles to her brother Carl, after which Carl had more marbles than Bea. Bea entered the remaining marbles in a contest where each marble earns 7 points, and the judge doubled her points for the neatest display. She spent 815 points on a prize. How many points does Bea have left?
w10_T4_000147: In the morning 3 trucks each delivered 202 crates to the warehouse, and 67 crates were brought out of the back room to join them. The warehouse is 40 metres long. In the afternoon every crate was opened; each holds 4 boxes, and 2256 boxes were dispatched. In the evening the remaining boxes were sold at 5 dollars each. How many dollars did the evening sale bring in?
w10_T4_000148: The greengrocer had 185 apples on Monday, and 83 of them sold whole. A dozen regular customers came by that afternoon. He cut each remaining apple into 6 wedges for the sample tray. There were 39 wedges already on the tray and 22 more in the fridge, which he added. How many apple wedges does he have?
w10_T4_000149: Farmer Ndlovu, who milks his herd twice a day, had 232 gallons of milk in the tank. A neighbour added 57 gallons, and 54 gallons were used for cheese. He measures deliveries in pints, and there are 8 pints in a gallon. The pints are divided equally among 5 shops. How many pints does the corner shop receive?
w10_T4_000150: Ravi's class account had 88 reward points. He earned 23 points for homework and then spent 108 points on a class party. The class has 28 students. His teacher opened a new term ledger for Ravi, starting it with the points he had left. He then earned 42 ledger points for reading, 74 for a science project, and 67 for helping in the library, while his classmate Sana has fewer ledger points than Ravi. How many points are on Ravi's term ledger?
w10_T4_000159: The community garden had 145 seedlings, and 136 of them were planted out. Then 41 seedlings were donated, 78 were bought, and 66 were grown from cuttings. The garden has 12 plots. Each seedling needs 4 stakes, and each stake costs 5 cents. How many cents will the stakes cost?
w10_T4_000163: Yusuf and Elena ran a lemonade stand. Yusuf sold 137 cups on Saturday and 70 cups on Sunday, at 3 dollars a cup, and he was given 25 dollars in tips. Elena's own sales came to less than Yusuf's. Yusuf gave half of his money to Elena for supplies. How many dollars does Yusuf keep?
w10_T4_000167: Ana had 72 pencils. She gave 23 to her friend Ben, who asked twice before she agreed, and then 14 of her pencils snapped. Ben still has fewer pencils than Ana. Ana sold each of her remaining pencils for 6 pesos and then found 31 pesos in her desk. How many pesos does Ana have?
w10_T4_000171: The gym had 56 members in January. It gained 24 members in February, 31 in March, and 41 in April. The gym, open a dozen hours a day, has 18 treadmills. Every member pays 7 dollars a week, but the gym refunded 184 dollars in a week for a broken sauna. If every week of the 4-week month brought in the same amount, how many dollars did the gym collect over the month?
w10_T4_000174: A fence needs 130 feet of rails. The builder added 7 feet for a gate and 42 feet for a corner section, then removed 77 feet where a hedge stands instead. The fence will get 2 coats of paint. The supplier sells rails by the yard, and there are 3 feet in a yard. How many yards of rails does the builder order?
w10_T4_000180: Priyanka shared 102 cookies equally among 3 friends, herself included, and then ate 24 of hers. The oven, which she checked twice, was set to 180 degrees. She baked 30 more cookies and then sold every cookie she had for 4 coins each. How many coins did Priyanka get?
w10_T4_000184: A brewery filled 106 kegs with 5 gallons each. The bottling line works in pints, and there are 8 pints in a gallon. During bottling 660 pints were lost to spillage. Each remaining pint sold for 8 dollars. How many dollars did the brewery earn?
w10_T4_000186: In the morning Tomas reviewed his project plan: 152 weeks were scheduled and 141 weeks were already complete. In the afternoon his manager cut 2 weeks from what remained, and Tomas converted the remaining time into days, at 7 days to a week. In the evening the client asked for 60 extra days of testing. His colleague Piotr has fewer days left on his own project than Tomas does. How many days remain on Tomas's project?
w10_T4_000188: At the fair 200 balloons were divided equally among 5 stalls. Mira's stall sold 38 balloons in the first hour, and then she received 65 more from the store tent. The fair opened at 9 o'clock. A promotion doubled her stock of balloons, and then 4 balloons popped. Her friend Dev's stall sold fewer balloons than Mira's. How many balloons does Mira have?
w10_T4_000204: In the morning the carpet warehouse held 240 rolls of 6 square yards each, and 438 square yards were sold before lunch. In the afternoon another 643 square yards were sold, and 34 square yards came back as a return. In the evening 133 square yards were found to be damaged and written off. The manager then restated the remaining stock in square feet, since a square yard is 9 square feet. How many square feet of carpet remain?
w10_T4_000208: In the morning the bakery had 61 loaves and sold 55 of them. The bakery opens at 7. In the afternoon each remaining loaf was cut into 4 thick slices, and every slice was halved into 2 pieces for sandwiches. In the evening 64 pieces from a second batch were added, and all the pieces were shared equally into 4 baskets. How many pieces are in the first basket?
w10_T4_000215: The scout troop had 81 merit badges in its cupboard. It gave 28 badges to new scouts and bought 26 more. Each badge counts for 7 points in the district scoring. The troop spent 413 points to book a camping trip and 56 points on a trophy. How many points does the troop have left?
